title: Kissed Tender Ethiopian Oyster Skewers
description: Tender oysters marinated in a rich Ethiopian wine and spice blend, served on toasted double-rise bread for a romantic date-night dinner.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together red wine, berbere spice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the oysters to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated oysters onto skewers, leaving a small space between each oyster.
Brush the double-rise bread cubes with olive oil and toast until lightly browned.
Grill the oyster skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the grilled oysters on top of the toasted bread cubes.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
